question: The sides of a triangle are 20 cm, 21 cm and 29 cm. The area of the triangle formed by joining the mid points of the sides of triangle will be:
solution:
**Given:**

ABC is a triangle.

AB = 20 cm; BC = 21 cm ; AC = 29 cm

D, E, and F are the midpoints of AB, BC and AC respectively.

**Concept used:**

The line segment joining the midpoint of any two sides of the triangle is parallel 

and half of the length of the third side.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/336b0fbcf468ead50ce800559bc91806dc6bfa66786208fa1cdd03254cbc2320.png] 

In the figure, D, E, and F are the midpoints of AB, BC and AC respectively.

From the midpoint theorem:

DE = 21/2 = 10.5 cm ; EF = 20/2 = 10 cm ; DF = 29/2 = 14.5 cm

Semi - perimeter (S) = (DE + EF + DF)/2

⇒ (10.5 + 10 + 14.5)/2

⇒ 35/2 = 17.5 cm

Area of triangle = √{S(S - DE) × (S - EF) × (S - DF)}

⇒ √{17.5 × (17.5 - 10.5) × (17.5 - 10) × (17.5 - 14.5)}

⇒ √{17.5 × 7 × 7.5 × 3}

⇒ √2756.25 = 52.5 = 52 (1)/(2) cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 52 (1)/(2) cm2.**** **
